longwall panel. The predicted curves closely follow themeasured subsidence envelopes if

Although the proposed model provides reliable subsidence prediction for moderately
inclined seams,several opportunities exist to extend thisresearchfurther.Some possible
deformation still propagates in apredictablegeometricmanner.For steep
inclinations,the overburden movement becomes highly asymmetric and nonlinear.
Extending the mathematical model to handle steep dips will significantly enhance
its applicability in structurally disturbed coalfields.
